title.purpose: Card and lesson titles; always Lora.

body.purpose: Articles and descriptions; Inter at 1.7 line-height, max 75ch.

shadows.name: glow

shadows.name: card-hover

shadows.name: card

components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Give Button
components.description: The one gold-filled element per screen (One Flame Rule): the giving CTA with a resting glow.
components.css: .ds-btn-give { background: #E8A020; color: #3D1F0A; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; padding: 16px 56px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 0 24px 4px rgba(232,160,32,0.18); transition: background 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-give:hover { background: #C48A18; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 0 48px 8px rgba(232,160,32,0.22); } .ds-btn-give:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C45E1A; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: parchment outline that brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #FDF6EC; font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; padding: 16px 40px; border: 1px solid rgba(253,246,236,0.3); border-radius: 9999px; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(253,246,236,0.6); background: rgba(253,246,236,0.06); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #C45E1A; outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: The homepage hero, light breaking through a stone doorway into darkness, is not a picture on this site; it is the doctrine the whole system obeys. Every page is a threshold. The ground is always warm darkness, and meaning arrives as light: a gold glow behind a title, a candle-warm card edge, a verse set apart in its own pool of warmth. Glow always has a source and a direction. The personality is reverent, warm, alive: cinematic darkness without gloom. Interactive elements are kindled: touching them breathes light into them, like breath on embers.
keyCharacteristics: Warm darkness as the canvas; light as the information
One serif voice (Lora) for everything sacred and headline; one sans (Inter) for everything that serves
Gold is scarce and always means light; orange means action
Motion rises and glows, slow and exponential, never bouncy
Scripture is set apart and honored on every page it appears

rules.name: The One Flame Rule
rules.body: At most one gold-filled element per screen: the giving CTA. Everywhere else, gold is light, not paint: text, hairlines, glow. If two gold fills appear at once, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Falling Light Rule
rules.body: Gold never appears as an even coat. Every gold glow, hairline, or radial has an implied source above or behind the content, consistent with a doorway you cannot quite see.

rules.name: The Scripture Setting Rule
rules.body: Scripture is always set in Lora italic at comfortable size, visually set apart, with an attributed reference in gold that links to the passage. Scripture never appears inline as decoration.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: On dark ground, elevation is always expressed as glow or tonal lightening, never as a dark drop shadow.

dos: Do keep the ground warm: every dark surface is a brown, never gray or pure black; every light text is parchment, never #fff.
Do give every glow a direction and source; radials sit behind titles or above sections.
Do reserve gold fills for the single giving CTA per screen.
Do set scripture apart in Lora italic with a gold attributed reference.
Do ease out exponentially (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)) at 200 to 700ms; respect prefers-reduced-motion everywhere.
Do keep touch targets at 44px and text contrast at 4.5:1 or better.
donts: Don't build anything that could pass for a dated church website: no clip-art doves, no rainbow gradients, no 2010 template energy.
Don't drift into tech-product territory: no pastel SaaS gradients, no floating glass cards, no hero-metric blocks.
Don't use black drop shadows on dark pages, gradient text, side-stripe borders, or decorative glassmorphism.
Don't animate layout properties, and never bounce or overshoot; motion is breath, not spring.
Don't let the site go cold: a page with no gold anywhere has lost the doorway.
